hypothesis_origin: Post-hoc descriptive grouping of the already-seen original 81-trade ledger; not an independent hypothesis or untouched test.

single_change.kind: entry qualification only; no cap40 or new exit
single_change.comparison: closed price at decision t >= closed price at t-180; equality allowed
single_change.episode_policy: At the first eligible decision of each original long target episode, allow or reject the entire episode. A rejected episode stays flat until original target resets to zero; no late entry and no reentry.
single_change.exit_policy: Once admitted, retain original long/flat target until its original z>=0 exit, even if 30d return later turns negative.
single_change.warm_start: Account and episode admission state restart at each cohort boundary. First known decision is start_index-lag; inherited original long state is checked there as a fresh possible account entry.
single_change.cold_july: Original MR targets remain month-only with original first-open skip; only the momentum feature uses available prior closed history.
single_change.missing_context: Reject entry if fewer than 180 preceding intervals are available.
single_change.execution: Signal-close decision; next-open fill at lag1, or one additional bar at lag2. Momentum is evaluated at the signal decision, never on a later execution bar.
single_change.sizing: Unchanged all-cash long/flat, 10000 USDT independently per cohort/profile.

evaluation.cohorts: All six pinned baseline cohorts, including cold and warm July; all already seen.
evaluation.profiles: normal 10 fee/5 slippage bps; stress 25/15; zero-cost diagnostic; additional4h latency at normal costs
evaluation.primary_comparison: Paired 42-month normal and stress net PnL and maximum close drawdown; report continuous August-September separately.

prior_related_trial: cap40 timing exit was tested once and rejected; this study does not include that change.
